func_800086C4_92C4.title: Bind a display object to texture descriptors
func_800086C4_92C4.summary: Stores a texture descriptor and its bank pointer on a native display object.
behavior: The helper stores its second argument (MIPS a1) as the display object's descriptor pointer at +0x34.
It stores its third argument (MIPS a2) as the display object's descriptor-bank pointer at +0x14.
The descriptor and bank pointers occupy separate fields and are both used by native display paths.
func_800086C4_92C4.returns: Return behavior was not established by the inspected native call path.
cautions: The caller's ownership and lifetime guarantees for either pointer are not established here.
No complete public C prototype is claimed.
func_800086C4_92C4.exampleExplanation: Observation-only example for the two verified display-object fields; it does not assert the helper's complete native signature.

func_80010230_10E30.title: Register a native texture descriptor
func_80010230_10E30.summary: Registers image metadata in the native texture-descriptor table and returns its runtime handle.
func_80010230_10E30.declaration: extern int func_80010230_10E30(unsigned short width, unsigned short height, unsigned char format, unsigned char flags, void *pixels, unsigned short palette);

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Image width supplied to the descriptor.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Image height supplied to the descriptor.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format byte stored for the descriptor; individual values are not established here.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags byte stored for the descriptor; individual bits are not established here.

parameters.name: pixels
parameters.description: Pixel-data pointer recorded for the descriptor.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Palette value supplied to the descriptor.

func_80010230_10E30.returns: A runtime descriptor handle on success, or -1 when registration cannot allocate a descriptor.
behavior: The native registry has 40 texture-descriptor slots. Registration records image dimensions, format and flags bytes, a pixel pointer, and a palette value.
The returned handle identifies a registered descriptor for native sprite commands. A handle is runtime state and is not a resource ID.
The format-byte and flags-byte encodings are not established by this interface description.
cautions: Unregister descriptors with the matching handle when their owning image data or scene lifetime ends.
A newly registered sprite's visibility during a scene's first introductory animation has not been tested.
func_80010230_10E30.exampleExplanation: This example shows the native argument shape only. Format, flags, palette, and pixel-buffer requirements must match the image data and caller context.

func_800102E0_10EE0.title: Unregister a native texture descriptor
func_800102E0_10EE0.summary: Clears a registered texture descriptor by its runtime handle.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Runtime handle returned by texture-descriptor registration.

func_800102E0_10EE0.returns: No return value is used by the inspected native caller; whether the routine returns an ignored value is unconfirmed.
behavior: The routine clears the texture-descriptor entry selected by the supplied handle.
The stock overlay invokes this cleanup for each handle it previously registered. The registry contains 40 descriptor slots.
cautions: Pass a handle returned for a live registration. The routine does not establish ownership or lifetime for the caller's pixel memory.
func_800102E0_10EE0.exampleExplanation: Release a descriptor using the handle saved when the image was registered.

func_80010358_10F58.title: Reset a native sprite queue
func_80010358_10F58.summary: Resets the pending sprite-record count for a native sprite queue.

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Queue index returned by native sprite-queue creation.

behavior: Resets the queue's pending record count so a later collection pass can append sprites again.
Resetting a queue does not release its backing buffer; use the queue cleanup routine when its lifetime ends.
cautions: Keep the queue allocated for as long as later append and finalize calls use its index.
func_80010358_10F58.exampleExplanation: Reset the pending sprite list at the start of a collection pass.

func_80010374_10F74.title: Free a native sprite queue
func_80010374_10F74.summary: Releases the backing buffer owned by a native sprite queue.

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Queue index returned by native sprite-queue creation.

func_80010374_10F74.returns: No return value is used by the inspected native caller; whether the routine returns an ignored value is unconfirmed.
behavior: Loads the queue's backing-buffer pointer and passes that exact allocation to the native scene-pool free routine.
This releases queue storage. It is separate from resetting pending records or finalizing a draw list.
cautions: Do not append or finalize through a queue after its backing buffer has been released.
func_80010374_10F74.exampleExplanation: Call when the queue's owning scene or display lifetime ends.

func_800103DC_10FDC.title: Create a native sprite queue
func_800103DC_10FDC.summary: Allocates a persistent native sprite-queue child and its fixed-capacity record buffer.
func_800103DC_10FDC.declaration: extern int func_800103DC_10FDC(void *task, int capacity, unsigned char display_layer);

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Native task that owns the queue child.

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Number of sprite records requested for this queue's backing buffer.

parameters.name: display_layer
parameters.description: Display layer value passed to the queue child; other layer semantics are not established here.

func_800103DC_10FDC.returns: A queue index on success, or -1 if queue creation or record-buffer allocation fails.
behavior: Creates a child of native task kind 1 and allocates a backing buffer for the requested record capacity. The global native registry supports at most 16 queues.
The queue persists across collection passes until its storage is explicitly released or scene-level native cleanup runs.
The queue index is consumed by reset, append, finalize, and cleanup calls.
cautions: The queue registry supports at most 16 live queues. Append no more records than this queue's requested capacity; append failure is reported as -1.
A newly created sprite queue's visibility during a scene's first introductory animation has not been tested.
func_800103DC_10FDC.exampleExplanation: Create the queue with a native owner task, a capacity no greater than 16, and the layer value required by the caller's draw path.

func_800105AC_111AC.title: Finalize a native sprite queue
func_800105AC_111AC.summary: Marks the end of a native sprite queue's pending display records.

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Queue index returned by native sprite-queue creation.

func_800105AC_111AC.returns: No return value is used by the inspected native caller; whether the routine returns an ignored value is unconfirmed.
behavior: Writes the native 0x8000 end marker after the queue's pending records so the display consumer can stop at the end of the list.
Finalization does not free the queue buffer; call the queue cleanup routine when its lifetime ends.
cautions: Finalize after appending the records for the current collection pass.
func_800105AC_111AC.exampleExplanation: Close the current record list after all desired sprites have been appended.

func_800106F0_112F0.title: Append a sprite to a native queue
func_800106F0_112F0.summary: Appends one 12-byte sprite record to a native sprite queue.
func_800106F0_112F0.declaration: extern int func_800106F0_112F0(int queue, short x, short y, unsigned short width, unsigned short height, int texture_handle, short s, short t);

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Queue index returned by native sprite-queue creation.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Horizontal position supplied for this sprite record.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Vertical position supplied for this sprite record.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width supplied for this sprite record.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height supplied for this sprite record.

parameters.name: texture_handle
parameters.description: Native texture-descriptor handle used by this sprite record.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: S texture coordinate supplied for the record.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: T texture coordinate supplied for the record.

func_800106F0_112F0.returns: The appended record index, or -1 if the queue cannot accept another record.
behavior: Appends a fixed 12-byte record containing the supplied position, dimensions, texture handle, and texture coordinates.
Under the o32 ABI, height, texture_handle, s, and t occupy caller stack slots 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, and 0x1C relative to the argument area.
The native registry supports at most 16 live queues. Each queue's record capacity is supplied when it is created.
cautions: Pass a live texture handle returned by native descriptor registration.
The visual result of adding a sprite during a scene's first introductory animation has not been tested.
func_800106F0_112F0.exampleExplanation: Append one sprite using a live texture descriptor and the coordinates required by its image sheet.

func_801FBB30_5B7A40.title: Initialize the native player-heart display
func_801FBB30_5B7A40.summary: Creates and initializes the native display object used by the player-heart HUD.
behavior: Creates one child display object through the native kind-1 display allocator.

Initializes the object's texture descriptor, writes 0.5 to the horizontal and vertical scale fields at +0x2C and +0x30, and sets bit 0x04 in the display-object byte at +0x08 to enable those scale values.
The renderer's scale path ignores the floating-point scale fields unless byte +0x08 has bit 0x04 set.
The companion heart updater uses native atlas descriptors for full/current, empty/maximum, base, and half-heart images.
cautions: The function initializes the stock player HUD object; it does not establish boss-health ownership or boss-specific damage semantics.
func_801FBB30_5B7A40.exampleExplanation: This observation-only example avoids asserting a native callable signature that has not been recovered.

func_801FBD50_5B7C60.title: Update the native player-heart display
func_801FBD50_5B7C60.summary: Builds the stock player-heart display from current and maximum health measured in half-heart units.
behavior: Reads the native current-health and maximum-health halfword values in half-heart units and clamps the displayed range to 0x28 units (20 hearts).

Selects heart imagery from the native descriptor arrays: current/full heart at atlas coordinate (0, 24), maximum/empty heart at (8, 24), base image at (16, 24), and half-heart image using the same red cell at (0, 24).

The half-heart is rendered as a 4 by 4 red heart at offset (+2,+2) over the 8 by 8 dark-heart base. It does not use a separate semi-transparent texture or alpha treatment; the native scale-enable bit and 0.5 object scales produce the smaller image.
The descriptor bank uses native image resource 0x8004, a 64 by 32 RGBA5551 sheet. Each full heart represents two native health units; the half-heart descriptor represents one unit.
cautions: This mapping describes the native player HUD. Congo's separate health counter is a byte at boss task +0x8D with a native range of 0 through 30; mapping two Congo units to one displayed heart is a separate presentation choice, not a native player-health equivalence.
The atlas coordinates describe source image locations, not screen positions.
func_801FBD50_5B7C60.exampleExplanation: This observation-only example represents the verified health units without asserting an unrecovered native callable signature.
